info.name: NIT Academy — App Endpoints
info.description:
Anonymous, pre-login endpoints the white-label mobile app reads per tenant.

1. App settings  — GET {{baseUrl}}/local/multitopics/getsettings.php
2. Design system — GET {{baseUrl}}/theme/nit/design_system.php

Set the collection variable `baseUrl` to an academy wwwroot (https, no trailing slash), e.g. https://test.academy2026.nitg-eg.com. Each request's Tests tab validates the app contract from BACKEND_ENDPOINTS.md (every settings value a string/null; site object present; features rule; anonymous logo).
